title: 第17章 哪一个苏家第18章 张宿出手光影杀剑圆满
slug: 满级武圣从绝世神功开始
content_zh:
何雄飞笑了。
他那魁梧如熊的身体，直接从马背上翻身而下。
能看得出，那匹马似乎都轻松了不少。
“既然是李总镖头亲自邀战，我岂有不应之理？不过，我的手重，李总镖头不知能不能扛住？”
何雄飞直接从马背上抓过了一柄刀。
这是一柄厚背刀。
这刀一看就是势大力沉。
恐怕得有几十斤。
能舞动这种重量的大刀，足见何雄飞的力量有多么恐怖。
看到何雄飞手中的厚背刀，李贺心中一沉。
但他也知道，如今箭在弦上不得不发了。
他是总镖头，就得为这趟镖负责。
若不动手，任由何雄飞抢走了这趟镖，那他的镇远镖局也就不用开了。
“我年龄虽然有些大了，但筋骨尚好，不碍事。”
“李总镖头，请。”
于是，两人当即站在了客栈外。
李武石和李小嫚都很紧张。
毕竟，对方是悍匪飞天刀何雄飞，而且手中那柄厚背刀，一看就非同一般。
他们也在担心父亲的安危。
看到两名江湖武者要“战斗”，刚才一窝蜂躲到客栈二楼的客人，也都探头探脑来到了客栈外看热闹。

张宿也和其他人一样，对两人之间的战斗很感兴趣。
毕竟，张宿其实没经历过江湖。
也不知道真正的江湖人究竟是什么实力？
李贺以及这个何雄飞，看样子在江湖中都是小有名气的武者。
在一定程度上，他们两人的实力，也能从侧面反映出如今江湖的水准。
张宿挤在人群中，目光在二人身上一一扫过。
尤其注意何雄飞手中的那柄厚背刀。
这柄厚背刀可不轻。
这一战，李贺恐怕不会轻松。
“铿”。
率先拔刀的是李贺。
他被江湖人称“鬼头刀”，刀法凌厉诡异，又颇为狠辣。
面对何雄飞，李贺不敢有一丝小觑。
甚至都不敢托大，选择主动出手。
一片冷厉的刀光，瞬间笼罩住了何雄飞。
这一刀，想要躲开也很难。
content_en:
He Xiongfei smiled.
His burly bear-like body rolled directly off the horse.
It can be seen that the horse seems to be much more relaxed.
"Since Mr. Li is the one personally inviting the fight, why should I not respond? However, my hand is heavy. I wonder if Mr. Li can handle it?"
He Xiongfei grabbed a knife directly from the horse's back.
This is a thick-backed knife.
This sword looks powerful and heavy at first glance.
I'm afraid it must weigh dozens of kilograms.
Being able to wield a sword of this weight shows how terrifying He Xiongfei's power is.
Li He's heart sank when he saw the thick-backed knife in He Xiongfei's hand.
But he also knew that now the arrow was on the string and had to be fired.
As the head escort, he has to take responsibility for this escort trip.
If he didn't take action and allowed He Xiongfei to snatch the escort, then his Zhenyuan escort agency would not need to be opened.
"Although I am a bit older, my muscles and bones are still good, so I won't be in trouble."
"Mr. Li, escort chief, please."
So, the two of them immediately stood outside the inn.
Li Wushi and Li Xiaoman were both nervous.
After all, the opponent is the fierce bandit Feitian Dao He Xiongfei, and the thick-backed knife in his hand is extraordinary at first glance.
They are also worried about their father's safety.
Seeing that the two Jianghu warriors were about to "fight", the guests who had just swarmed to hide on the second floor of the inn also poked their heads outside the inn to watch the excitement.
Zhang Su, like everyone else, was very interested in the battle between the two.
After all, Zhang Su has never experienced the world.
I don’t know what the real strength of Jianghu people is?
Li He and He Xiongfei seemed to be well-known warriors in the world.
To a certain extent, the strength of the two of them can also reflect the current level of the world.
Zhang Su squeezed into the crowd and glanced at the two of them one by one.
Pay special attention to the thick-backed knife in He Xiongfei's hand.
This thick-backed knife is not light.
This battle may not be easy for Li He.
"Keng".
The first one to draw the sword was Li He.
He is known as the "Ghost Sword" by people in the world because of his sharp and strange sword skills and is quite cruel.
Facing He Xiongfei, Li He did not dare to look down upon him.
He didn't even dare to make excuses and chose to take the initiative.
A cold and sharp sword light instantly enveloped He Xiongfei.
It was difficult to dodge this knife.
